system.description: Your beast came from beyond the cairn-lights, and it is not a horse. Choose one extra passive for it: Cliff-Clawed (it climbs walls and cliffs at half speed, with you on its back), Bog-Strider (it ignores difficult terrain) or Gut-Biter (its attack deals d8). Ordinary beasts know what it is: horses, mules and dogs within 30' of it will not stay calm, and you can have no other animal as a minion.
